bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for downtown lakeshore improvements in the city of Wayzata; authorizing the sale and issuance of state bonds.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+WAYZATA; DOWNTOWN LAKESHORE IMPROVEMENTS. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Appropriation.+]

[+$14,915,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the city of Wayzata to acquire real property or interests in real property for, and to design, construct, furnish, and equip the final phase of Wayzata's downtown lakefront restoration, including construction of an eco park, restoration and preservation of the historic Section Foreman House and Wayzata Depot site, restoration of lake edge on Lake Minnetonka, improvements to the Wayzata Beach and Klapprich Park, as well as design for new public safety facilities that will directly serve the needs of the downtown lakefront and community park improvements. This appropriation is in addition to the appropriation for a portion of this project in Laws 2020, Fifth Special Session chapter 3, article 1, section 21, subdivision 45. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Bond sale.+]

[+To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $14,915,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for downtown lakeshore improvements in the city of Wayzata; authorizing the sale and issuance of state bonds.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. WAYZATA; DOWNTOWN LAKESHORE IMPROVEMENTS.

Subdivision 1.

Appropriation.

$14,915,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the city of Wayzata to acquire real property or interests in real property for, and to design, construct, furnish, and equip the final phase of Wayzata's downtown lakefront restoration, including construction of an eco park, restoration and preservation of the historic Section Foreman House and Wayzata Depot site, restoration of lake edge on Lake Minnetonka, improvements to the Wayzata Beach and Klapprich Park, as well as design for new public safety facilities that will directly serve the needs of the downtown lakefront and community park improvements. This appropriation is in addition to the appropriation for a portion of this project in Laws 2020, Fifth Special Session chapter 3, article 1, section 21, subdivision 45.

Subd. 2.

Bond sale.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $14,915,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.

This appropriation is in addition to the appropriation for a portion of this project in Laws 2020, Fifth Special Session chapter 3, article 1, section 21, subdivision 45.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $14,915,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
